name: Zen Stargazer
summary:
Zen Stargazer is a mixed-reality stargazing experience for Meta Quest. Your room stays real; the sky above follows your chosen time and location.

POINT TO LEARN
Aim the right controller at the sky to identify stars, planets, nebulae, and galaxies—with short educational notes for bright landmarks.

TIME & PLACE
Follow live “now,” or lock a custom observing time. Pick a city on the world map and the sky updates instantly—great for rehearsing a meteor peak or revisiting an eclipse night.
